item.title: Bierstadt’s Mountain Scene Is Collective Hudson’s Apex
item.description: KINGSTON, N.Y. — An oil on canvas landscape depicting Lander’s Peak in the Rocky Mountains, cataloged as a signed Albert Bierstadt painting and dated 1865, went to $33,750, including buyer’s premium, at Collective Hudson on February 8 in the firm’s Pre-Valentine Wonderful Sale.
